restaurant_name: Jas Green Village Bang Bua Thong
text:
Jas Green Village is a beautiful community mall.
Entering the mall, you'll feel the lushness of the trees. There's a small river inside the mall, with swans and ducks.
There are many restaurants, both famous ones and those renting space to open their own shops. These include Fuji, KFC, MK, Yayoi, Bonchon, and the Suki Teenoi buffet.
There's also Swenssense ice cream and many other shops. There's a food court (but it's very quiet; almost all the shops are gone, it seems like a break area for the mall employees).
There's a Starbucks coffee shop.
There's also a Tops Supermarket, a beauty clinic, a dental clinic, a massage parlor, a beauty salon, a pharmacy, a special education school, and many other things.

Come visit!

restaurant_name: Jas Green Village Bang Bua Thong
text: Jas Green Village has a huge variety of restaurants. This was my first time here. There's parking in both the front and back. If you park in the back, there's a shuttle service. The overall place is beautiful and nice to walk around. Today I ate at Shabu Shabu, and this branch was very impressive. The staff were all very attentive and quick; orders were fulfilled immediately. They constantly cleared plates from the tables. The food and the restaurant itself were clean. Unfortunately, I forgot to take pictures of the interior.

restaurant_name: Jas Green Village Bang Bua Thong
text: They're opening zone by zone. There's quite a lot of parking, but I'm not sure if it will be enough when all zones are open. The atmosphere is nice, both during the day and at night. Most of the area has roofs, so it's not too hot. There are plenty of restrooms. Each shop looks inviting.

restaurant_name: Jas Green Village Bang Bua Thong
